guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size), display: block on replaced elements like <iframe>, flex-wrap: wrap for wrapping lists, and overflow: auto for scroll containers without overflow: hidden clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and max-width: 100%, and wide tables scroll inside focusable regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic navigation landmarks focus visible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>), sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, descriptive iframe titles, and visible :focus-visible outlines.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, descriptive iframe title, and 3px :focus-visible outline on .table-wrap.

guidanceConsulted.query: technical documentation typography readability inline code headings
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use text-wrap: balance on headings and prevent long unbreakable tokens from causing narrow-viewport overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherited /public/styles.css heading balance without inline h1/pre/code overrides, and inserted <wbr> breakpoints into the 39-character CamelCase H1 so mobile wraps cleanly at word boundaries.
